profile.headline: Senior .NET Developer
profile.summary:
I'm a Senior Full Stack Developer with a strong focus on building scalable enterprise applications in the healthcare sector, using modern technologies like .NET 8/9, Angular latest versions, Vue.js , Azure, SQL Server and so on.

I have led development teams and contributed to software architecture, applying clean code principles and design patterns like Unit of Work, Factory, and Dependency Injection. I’m passionate about performance, maintainability, and solving real-world problems with efficient code.

🧩 Core Expertise:
Backend: .NET 6/8/9, ASP.NET Core, C#, Web APIs, Azure Functions, Entity Framework Core

Frontend: Vue 3, Vuetify, Angular (legacy projects), JavaScript, HTML, CSS

Cloud & DevOps: Azure, Docker, GitHub Actions, CI/CD pipelines

Databases: Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL

Mobile: Xamarin Forms, .NET MAUI

Architecture: Clean Architecture, DDD, Microservices

I've delivered solutions that optimize patient workflows, enable secure data processing, and support national healthcare systems. Currently exploring AI integration with Azure, and planning to expand into iOS native development using Swift.
